moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals wrap up
moments.blurb: The twin festivals, Reading and Leeds, concluded yesterday after four days of rock, indie, and dance music across Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park.

angles.name: Festival Afterglow
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Reading & Leeds 2026! Who are you still buzzing about from the weekend? From Fontaines D.C. to Charli XCX, it was massive. #RandL26

angles.name: Line-up Recap
angles.copy: The dust has settled on Reading & Leeds. Kasabian, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Chase & Status Live... what was your highlight?

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 2 concludes
moments.blurb: The second weekend of the Premier League season wrapped up yesterday, with some surprising results including Manchester United's 5-2 win over Ipswich and Chelsea's narrow 4-3 victory against Brighton.

angles.name: Weekend Review
angles.copy: Premier League Matchday 2 is DONE. Man Utd hit five, Chelsea edged it, and Leeds drew with Brentford. What was the biggest shock or best game for you?

angles.name: Monday Morning Verdict
angles.copy: Still dissecting the Premier League weekend? From Crystal Palace vs Man City on Friday to Sunday's goal-fests, it's been a wild start to the season.

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off kicks off this Wednesday, September 2nd, with a new batch of bakers and Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to pre-heat your ovens! The Great British Bake Off is back this Wednesday, Sep 2, with a fresh tent and new judge Nigella Lawson. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The new series starts Wednesday on Channel 4. What bakes are you hoping to see this year?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing launch date revealed
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of Strictly Come Dancing will air its pre-recorded launch show on Saturday, September 19th, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: The glitterball countdown is ON! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show airs September 19th with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe. Get ready for the pairings!

angles.name: New Strictly Hosts
angles.copy: Strictly's got new presenters! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe are taking the reins. Catch the launch show on Sep 19.

moments.title: Meteorological Autumn begins
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, September 1st, marks the start of meteorological autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, bringing with it the promise of cooler weather and changing leaves.

angles.name: Autumn Vibes
angles.copy: Goodbye Summer, hello Autumn! Meteorological autumn officially starts tomorrow, September 1st. What's your favourite thing about the new season?

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: The calendar says autumn starts tomorrow! Time for pumpkin spice everything and cosy nights in. What are you looking forward to this season?

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Day
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Queen Bey, Beyoncé! Celebrate with us by cranking up your favourite track. What's it going to be?

angles.name: Iconic Tracks
angles.copy: From 'Crazy In Love' to 'Break My Soul', Beyoncé has given us so many anthems. Join us in wishing her a very Happy 45th Birthday on September 4th!

moments.title: Barry Gibb turns 80
moments.blurb: Bee Gees legend Barry Gibb celebrates his 80th birthday tomorrow, September 1st.

angles.name: Disco Icon's Big 80
angles.copy: Tomorrow, September 1st, we're wishing a very Happy 80th Birthday to the legendary Barry Gibb! What's your favourite Bee Gees track to celebrate?

angles.name: Bee Gees Legacy
angles.copy: Stayin' Alive for 80 years! Happy Birthday to Barry Gibb tomorrow. His falsetto defined an era. What's your go-to Bee Gees song?

moments.title: Roger Waters turns 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters on September 6th! What's your favourite iconic track from the band?

angles.name: The Wall & Beyond
angles.copy: From 'The Wall' to 'Dark Side of the Moon', Roger Waters' influence is undeniable. Happy 83rd on Sunday! What's your top Pink Floyd album?

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
moments.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders on September 7th! What's your favourite track from the rock icon?

angles.name: Rock & Roll Woman
angles.copy: A true rock and roll pioneer! Wishing Chrissie Hynde a fantastic 75th birthday next Monday. Her voice is unmistakable.

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor turns 83
moments.blurb: Disco queen Gloria Gaynor, famous for 'I Will Survive', celebrates her 83rd birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Queen's Day
angles.copy: We will survive and celebrate! Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Gloria Gaynor on September 7th. What's your favourite disco anthem from her?

angles.name: I Will Survive Legacy
angles.copy: An absolute legend! Wishing Gloria Gaynor a very Happy 83rd Birthday next Monday. Her music still fills dancefloors worldwide.

moments.title: Pink turns 47
moments.blurb: Pop-rock superstar Pink celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Get The Party Started
angles.copy: Get the party started! Wishing a very Happy 47th Birthday to the incredible Pink on September 8th. What's your ultimate Pink power anthem?

angles.name: Pop-Rock Royalty
angles.copy: From 'Family Portrait' to 'So What', Pink always delivers. Happy 47th Birthday next Tuesday to a true pop-rock icon!

moments.title: End Of The Road Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The End Of The Road Festival, known for its indie and alternative line-up, runs from September 3rd to 6th in Larmer Tree Gardens, Dorset.

angles.name: Indie Festival Vibes
angles.copy: End Of The Road Festival starts this Thursday! Four days of amazing indie and alternative artists in Dorset. Who's heading down?

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival begins
moments.blurb: Lindisfarne Festival, a multi-genre music and arts event, takes place from September 3rd to 5th in Northumberland.

angles.name: North East Festival
angles.copy: Lindisfarne Festival is back this Thursday for a weekend of music and arts on the Northumberland coast! Who are you hoping to catch?

moments.title: The British Country Music Festival in Blackpool
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival brings world-class country and Americana artists to Blackpool from September 4th to 6th.

angles.name: Country Comes to Blackpool
angles.copy: Yeehaw! The British Country Music Festival kicks off this Friday in Blackpool, Sep 4-6. Get ready for a weekend of amazing country and Americana music!

moments.title: Reminisce Festival for dance nostalgia
moments.blurb: Reminisce Festival, celebrating 90s and 00s dance music, returns to Sherdley Park, St Helens, on Saturday, September 12th.

angles.name: Throwback Dance Party
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive throwback! Reminisce Festival is bringing 90s and 00s dance anthems to St Helens on September 12th. Who's digging out their raving gear?

moments.title: Jeff Buckley tribute in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Slow Pilot will perform 'The Songs of Jeff Buckley' at Saint Luke's in Glasgow tomorrow, September 1st.

angles.name: Buckley's Grace in Glasgow
angles.copy: A special night for Jeff Buckley fans! Slow Pilot perform his songs, including 'Grace', at Saint Luke's Glasgow tomorrow, Sep 1.

moments.title: Arrested Development in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Legendary American hip-hop group Arrested Development play Oran Mor in Glasgow on Wednesday, September 2nd.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legends Live
angles.copy: Fly, don't walk! Arrested Development are bringing their iconic hip-hop sound to Oran Mor, Glasgow, this Wednesday, Sep 2. Who's in?

moments.title: The Damn Truth play Exeter
moments.blurb: Canadian rock band The Damn Truth are performing at The Cavern in Exeter on Wednesday, September 2nd.

angles.name: Exeter Rock Night
angles.copy: Get ready to rock, Exeter! The incredible Canadian band The Damn Truth are at The Cavern this Wednesday, September 2nd. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Dennis Ellsworth at Exeter Phoenix
moments.blurb: Canadian singer-songwriter Dennis Ellsworth plays Exeter Phoenix on Thursday, September 3rd.

angles.name: Live Music in Exeter
angles.copy: Looking for live music this week? Dennis Ellsworth brings his captivating sound to Exeter Phoenix this Thursday, September 3rd.
